_comment: Intensity imaging tool. AutoForm over IntensityViewModel: a Controls dock (file; actions in the toolbar) and per-pixel map docks. The detector-window selector now lives in each map (channel combo); the Frames dock plays the raw per-frame intensity stack. Intensity is computed for every detector window from step-0 Setup and creates the standard imaging HDF5 (with source back-reference).
